project_info.theme: Toyota Vios passed down with peace of mind and easy ownership
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, white, warm gold, gray, leafy green

main_subject.detail: A bright outdoor sales-and-family poster with Toyota logo top left and large gold text 'AN TAM TRUYEN DOI TOYOTA VIOS'. Two men stand in front of a modern house and city skyline; the older man passes a car key to the younger man. A white Toyota Vios sedan is parked on the right in a front three-quarter view. Across the bottom are gold finance plates reading 'HO TRO TUONG DUONG 50% LE PHI TRUOC BA', 'LAI SUAT UU DAI CHI TU 7.49%/NAM', and 'TRA TRUOC 0 DONG'. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'. Small top-right note says the AI-generated details are for illustration only.
main_subject.style: Warm ownership-transfer automotive poster blending family trust, city-home lifestyle, and dealership-finance messaging

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Vios ownership-transfer campaign. Centerpiece is a symbolic key handover between an older and younger man beside a white Toyota Vios parked in a modern courtyard. Background is a bright city-home environment with skyline towers and a contemporary house facade. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact title 'AN TAM TRUYEN DOI TOYOTA VIOS', finance plates 'HO TRO TUONG DUONG 50% LE PHI TRUOC BA', 'LAI SUAT UU DAI CHI TU 7.49%/NAM', and 'TRA TRUOC 0 DONG', plus the footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal automotive lifestyle sales composite, bright lifestyle-commercial lighting, sunny premium atmosphere and clean highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
